description: This file is a JSON schema definition for the MaintenanceManager plugin, which provides an interface for managing maintenance activities on set-top devices. It defines methods, events, data structures, and external references to facilitate control and monitoring of maintenance states.

methods.name: getMaintenanceActivityStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current maintenance status details, including whether maintenance is idle, started, completed, or in error, along with additional info like last completion time and reboot status.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStartTime
methods.description: Fetches the scheduled maintenance start time in epoch format.

methods.name: setMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Configures maintenance mode and software upgrade opt-out mode, allowing control over how maintenance and updates proceed.

methods.name: startMaintenance
methods.description: Initiates maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: stopMaintenance
methods.description: Halts ongoing maintenance activities and triggers status change events.

methods.name: getMaintenanceMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current maintenance mode and opt-out settings.
